paper_title: The PVLAS experiment: measuring vacuum magnetic birefringence and dichroism with a birefringent Fabry-Perot cavity
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling constant
notes: Paper presents exclusion limits on axion-like particles (ALPs) from ellipticity and rotation measurements in a Fabry-Perot cavity polarimeter. Figure 14 shows the primary exclusion plot for ALPs in the (mass, coupling) plane at 95% CL. The ellipticity measurement dominates for m ≥ 1 meV with coupling g ~ 10^-5 GeV^-1 at the boundary. The rotation measurement provides complementary constraints at lower masses. The paper also presents limits on milli-charged particles (Figure 15) but the primary new result is the ALP exclusion. Data points extracted from Figure 14 represent approximate boundary values; the actual exclusion region is above these curves. The coupling convention is g_agamma in GeV^-1 as standard for axion-photon interactions.
